description: Retained Merkle-membership check for one depin_onchain observation: stamp_day (YYYYMMDD), leaf_index (0-based row in /attestations/batch_<day>.tsv), expected_row_sha256. verified=true ONLY when the row at that index hashes to expected_row_sha256 AND its inclusion path reaches that day's manifest merkle_root. Says nothing about Bitcoin status or upstream accuracy. Other datasets: unsupported (no retained proof).
name: verify_footprint
